name: Dispel Magic

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Choose creature/object/magical effect; end each qualifying ongoing spell at or below paid slot; higher-level spell gets separate casting-ability check DC 10 plus spell level; do not erase unrelated nonspell sources.

rules.text: Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range.
Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends.
For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 plus that spell’s level).
On a successful check, the spell ends.
You automatically end a spell on the target if the spell’s level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you use.
